They share the specific subject of Intel Foundry's strategic business model and service offerings.

comparisons.peer_topic: Global manufacturing and assembly expansion initiatives
comparisons.peer_summary: The company began enabling cleanroom space for EUV lithography in Hiroshima, Japan, expanded an assembly and test facility in Xi'an, China, and is progressing construction of a facility in Gujarat, India to support future global customer demand.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and Micron disclose active investments in advanced packaging and assembly capacities to support complex semiconductor structures. Intel highlights its Foundry capabilities to 'packaging single chips or combining multiple chips together in a package, adjacent to each other, stacked on top of each other,' emphasizing systems-of-chips optimization. Similarly, Micron describes expanding its 'global back-end assembly and test network' and constructing new facilities in China and India to handle growing demand for advanced memory products, reflecting a shared industry focus on backend processing capabilities.

sentences.text: Intel Foundry's advanced semiconductor assembly and test offerings include families of advanced technologies for packaging single chips or combining multiple chips together in a package, adjacent to each other, stacked on top of each other, or through a combination thereof.
We also continue to advance our global back-end assembly and test network in order to support our product portfolio and extend our ability to deliver on global customer demand in the future.

comparisons.peer_summary: Automotive revenue for fiscal year 2024 was $1.1 billion, up 21% from fiscal year 2023. The company partnered with MediaTek for automotive SoCs, collaborated with Foxconn on electric vehicles, and expanded NVIDIA DRIVE platform adoption with multiple OEMs.
comparisons.comparison: Intel and NVIDIA both discuss chiplet and systems-level integration, though with different strategic emphases. Intel explicitly mentions driving the 'Universal Chiplet Interconnect Express (UCIe) standard for communication between chips in a system' to optimize systems of chips. NVIDIA similarly discusses partnerships involving chiplet technology, such as its collaboration with MediaTek to 'develop mainstream automotive systems on chips for global OEMs integrating a new NVIDIA GPU chiplet IP for AI and graphics,' indicating a shared interest in chiplet-based system designs.

sentences.text: We continue to drive the technologies, capabilities, and standards needed to optimize systems of chips, including the Universal Chiplet Interconnect Express* standard for communication between chips in a system, which we demonstrated in silicon in 2023.
In Automotive, we announced a partnership with MediaTek, which will develop mainstream automotive systems on chips for global OEMs integrating a new NVIDIA GPU chiplet IP for AI and graphics.
